description:
Froststrap is a fork of Bloxstrap and Fishstrap, focused on performance and customization.


Froststrap v2.0.6 - What's new?
The 2.0.6 cycle was all about performance: Native AOT, our build system rewritten from scratch, and a UI refresh.
Added
Native AOT
- Froststrap no longer requires .NET 10
- Startup times drop dramatically — low-end machines that used to see 8s should now see 1-2s
Other optimizations
- macOS native libraries for Avalonia now half the size
  - being able to control the libraries with AOT
  - running lipo on the binaries to go from collective 18MB due to universal to 9MB on arm/aarch64 systems
- Removal of under-utilised libraries dropped the binary size by another 4MB
Interface
- New titlebar design
  - Shows the current settings page title
  - Search and sidebar toggle buttons
  - Account manager moved to the top-right
  - About button takes the old account manager spot
- macOS Backdrop support
image
- Inter is now the font on all platforms, fixing macOS text alignment
- Scroll bars removed from scrollable pages for a more consistent layout
- Onboarding window enlarged (700×550 → 725×600) and re-spaced
- New color picker powered by FluentAvalonia
  - Removes ColorPicker dependency which dropped another 2MB
- Toggle to hide bootstrapper information on the splash screen (Appearance)
- Bootstrapper now trusts the window border, giving proper rounded corners on macOS and Windows
Features
- Move Storage — relocate the heavy Versions and Downloads directories
  - NTFS junctions on Windows, symlinks elsewhere
- Virtual Display customization
  - Custom name, width and height
  - macOS refresh rate (Hz) configuration
- Custom cursors now support .ani, .ico and .cur (converted to PNG internally)
- Join games from pasted Roblox links, plus creating shortcuts from game links (#221, @utophii)
- Refresh button in the Roblox servers window
- New diagnostics window (groundwork for now)
New argument parser
Help generation and a version system have been added. Old args map to new ones:
- -settings -> --settings
- -backgroundupdater -> --background-updater
- -nolaunch -> --no-launch
- -testmode -> --test-mode
- -upgrade -> --upgrade
- -player -> --player
- -studio -> --studio
- -channel -> --channel
- -force -> --force
- -gameshortcut -> --game-shortcut
- -console -> --console
- -nogpu -> --no-gpu
- -version -> --roblox-version
New flags: --help, --version.
Removed: watcher, onboarding, menu/preferences, quiet.
Invalid arguments now fail hard like a normal program, so if your client crashes, make sure your launch arguments only use ones from this list.
Fixed
- Bare --player and --studio failing to parse, which broke Save & Launch, desktop shortcuts and Studio launch
- Linux activity watcher closing before it should
- Activity watcher picking up the wrong logs (crash handler/installer logs, Studio switching)
- Virtual display not mirroring or not being set as the main display
- Sober URI parsing being garbled, so website launching now works
- "Skybox" string resource looking for the wrong case and showing blank
- .rpm failing to install on Fedora due to the libicu-dev dependency
- macOS Save & Launch splitting into multiple app lifetimes
- Cleaner treating its age setting as hours instead of days, not skipping on Never, and a 2000-file per-run limit
- Windows MSI now installs per-user, fixing error 2503 (#251)
- Discord RPC not working after the AOT work
- Free disk space check failing on unusual drives and paths
- Roblox crash handler now waited on after the watcher closes it
- Settings account dropdown not opening
- CardExpander being slow to close
- Logging now shows real call sites and stack traces
- JSON context generation issues
- Icons now sourced from PNG to keep the binary small
- Theme race condition after switching from backdrop
- %20 showing in preset flags instead of spaces
- Crash when VirtualDisplay data was null (rc.2 hotfix)
- macOS cached packages now integrity-checked against recorded hashes
- Account manager, Studio RPC after account switch, and key read/write issues (#236, #233, #232)
- LucideAvalonia launch overhead
- macOS bundle version string now valid
- Linux no longer prints stray update-mime-database output
- Grammar and string typo fixes (#249, @Chipislol)
Changed
- Avalonia renderers are now chosen explicitly per platform
  - Windows: AngleEgl, Wgl, Vulkan, Software
  - macOS: Metal, Software (OpenGL disabled)
  - Linux: Glx, Vulkan, Software
- Binary renamed from Froststrap to froststrap (froststrap.exe on Windows)
- Internal Bootstrapper page renamed from Behaviour, so it now matches the UI
- All pages rewritten to follow a common pattern
- macOS entitlements stripped down after AOT so JIT and sketchy sounding entitlements aren't needed anymore
- old bootstrapper leftovers relics from like 2023/2022
Packaging
- Arch Linux .tar.zst output is now supported
Nix
- now has mkFroststrap for shipping a new binary
- live builds
- ships the correct fontconfig version to avoid those fontconfig key warnings
Codebase
- The Fallout build system was replaced by an in-house Rust one
  - ~10x faster cold start on Linux
- macOS .app bundling is now hand-rolled with stdlib + Xcode CLI tools, removing the Xcode IDE dependency (~18x faster at bundling stage)
- macOS plist serialization/pretty-printing moved to our pissing crate (~390 lines removed)
- Launch handlers consolidated into a single point of failure
- backend now logs through an FFI layer into the C# logger
- Remote config signatures now use ECDSA P-256, dropping BouncyCastle
- NLog configuration moved into code
- objc2 crates only enable the features they need
- Rust now builds on the Nightly toolchain for faster CI
- macOS dylibs are lipo -thin'd to the target architecture
- AOT-friendly DataGrid replacement removed 3.3 MB of embedded resources
- Licenses page is data-driven via LicensesViewModel
- Translations moved to Resources/Translations
- Large round of dead code cleanup (~500 lines)
- Added a typos config
Full Changelog: v2.0.5...v2.0.6
